```yaml
name: UI Watchlists RC Gate

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - develop
    paths:
      - 'tldw_Server_API/**'
      - 'e2e/**'
      - '.github/workflows/ui-watchlists-rc-gate.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  cancel-previous:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: styfle/cancel-workflow-action@0.12.1
        with:
          access_token: ${{ github.token }}

  security-lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install bandit

      - name: Run Bandit Security Lint
        run: |
          python -m bandit -r \
            tldw_Server_API/app/api/v1/endpoints/media/ingest_jobs.py \
            tldw_Server_API/app/core/Jobs/manager.py \
            -f json \
            -o /tmp/bandit_quick_ingest_phase2.json
          
          # Check for findings (exit 1 if findings > 0)
          if [ -f /tmp/bandit_quick_ingest_phase2.json ]; then
            findings=$(cat /tmp/bandit_quick_ingest_phase2.json | python -c "import sys, json; data=json.load(sys.stdin); print(len(data.get('results', [])))")
            if [ "$findings" -gt 0 ]; then
              echo "::error::Bandit found $findings security issues."
              cat /tmp/bandit_quick_ingest_phase2.json
              exit 1
            else
              echo "No security findings."
            fi
          fi

  integration-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: security-lint
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          # Assuming requirements are in a standard file or need to be installed from pyproject.toml
          # Adjust this step based on your actual project structure
          if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; fi
          if [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then pip install .[dev,test]; fi
          pip install pytest pytest-asyncio

      - name: Run Integration Tests
        run: |
          python -m pytest -q \
            tldw_Server_API/tests/MediaIngestion_NEW/integration/test_ingest_jobs_batch_cancel.py \
            tldw_Server_API/tests/MediaIngestion_NEW/integration/test_ingest_jobs_events_stream.py \
            tldw_Server_API/tests/MediaIngestion_NEW/unit/test_ingest_jobs_batch_lookup.py

  e2e-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: security-lint
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install Playwright dependencies
        run: |
          npm install
          npx playwright install --with-deps

      - name: Start Server for E2E
        run: |
          # Start the server in the background
          # Adjust the command to match your actual server start command
          python -m uvicorn tldw_Server_API.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 &
          sleep 5 # Wait for server to start

      - name: Run E2E Tests
        run: |
          TLDW_E2E_SERVER_URL=127.0.0.1:8000 \
          TLDW_E2E_API_KEY=THIS-IS-A-SECURE-KEY-123-FAKE-KEY \
          npx playwright test e2e/workflows/media-ingest.spec.ts \
          --grep "should cancel quick ingest mid-process with confirmation" \
          --reporter=line

  all-green:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [security-lint, integration-tests, e2e-tests]
    if: always()
    steps:
      - uses: re-actors/alls-green@release/v1
        with:
          jobs: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
```
